Fleet — four synthetic tenants, one PE view

Two CSDE tenants (Enterprise and Essentials packaging) and two CSD tenants, each generated from its own declared family plan and provisioned into an isolation-enforced fleet: unique tenant systems, deep-frozen spines, one shared homogeneity predicate at provision and at every read. The rollup below is a read-only fold over per-tenant scorecards — it never joins spines, never averages KPI percentages, and refuses (typed) to sum across currencies.

Golden Dataset — the data, and the money already in it

The accelerator’s own synthetic CSD (Distribution SX.e) tenant — Brackenford Supply Co. — with its org, master, and transactional data, and the gross margin the margin agent already located in it. The gross-margin table is computed by the package; one family sits below the demo-basis floor (a demonstration threshold, not an Infor benchmark), surfaced with the agent’s own honest summary — and over the healthy families the agent DECLINES, which is shown here, not hidden.

Margin agent — the leak it located (proposed only, nothing executed)

margin — margin-leak-ABHIGH

PRD-ABR-300 (family AB @ EAST) realized GM% 16.67% is 8.33 pts below the demo-basis 25% gross-margin floor (a demonstration threshold, not an Infor benchmark): unit cost (icsw.replcost) 15.00 vs price (icsw.listprice) 18.00 → unit GM 3.00; realized revenue 38880.00 − COGS 32400.00 = GM 6480.00. Structurally thin, cost-driven margin: landed cost sits high against a list price never lifted to cover it (the cost-creep archetype, not price/rebate erosion).

PROPOSED — nothing executed PROPOSE: reprice PRD-ABR-300 or renegotiate its landed cost with the category desk (unit GM 3.00 at cost 15.00 / price 18.00). Human-confirmed only — no auto-execute.

carrier icsw.replcost vs icsw.listprice (unit GM% = (listprice − replcost)/listprice; realized GL rev 4000 vs COGS 5000)
Evidence (3 ref(s) — every one names a real record)
  • master:MR-PROD-PRD-ABR-300 — item master: replcost 15.00 (cost basis) vs listprice 18.00 (price basis)
  • inventory:IM-AB-202507-S — shipped issue carrying the cost basis (icetl.prodcost 15.00)
  • order:CO-AB-202506 — sales order carrying the price basis (oeel.price 18.00)

Margin agent over the healthy families — the honest decline

marginDECLINE — nothing proposed

every family's realized GM% is at or above the 25% floor — declining rather than inventing a margin leak where margin is fine

Non-controlling interest — the declared NCI% (100% - ownershipPct) share of each CONSOLIDATED, <100%-owned entity's post-policy/post-translation/post-elimination/post-PPA net assets (ASC 810-10). An entity carrying an in-effect PpaSchedule is a real roll-forward: a fixed acquisition-date beginning balance (translated ONCE at the acquisition-date rate declared for the PPA equity contra, never re-priced) plus this period's NCI% share of current-period result and of CTA (ASC 810-10-45-20). An entity with NO PpaSchedule (owned from day one — no acquisition event to roll forward from) is the simpler current NCI% share of the entity's own book equity. Informational — already embedded in the GC-EQUITY/GC-RE/CTA figures above (a decomposition of dollars already counted, never additional dollars); not a separate footing addend. 23,261.84 USD

Basis of preparation (computed legend)

  • Intercompany balance eliminations are performed ONLY for controller-signed, confirmed pairs (see the elimination ledger, drillable to both legs). Every other intercompany-candidate balance — unconfirmed, one-sided, or heuristic/AI-proposed — is flagged for elimination review, never netted or removed (see the per-candidate elimination status). Profit-in-inventory, revenue/COGS, and dividend eliminations are out of scope and never applied. At least one intercompany balance stayed flagged for review, never netted or removed, this build: SAPENT/160000.
  • Accounting-policy alignment across entities is limited to bases bridged by a controller-signed PolicyAdjustmentSchedule (journal-shaped, applied in local currency before translation). An entity whose declared accounting basis differs from the group target basis and carries NO in-effect schedule is withheld from this figure (a named refusal, never a silent inclusion) — see the per-entity basis statement. This is not a full multi-GAAP consolidation process.
  • Purchase accounting (fair-value step-ups, identified intangibles, and goodwill) is applied ONLY for a declared acquisition carrying a controller-signed PpaSchedule whose stated goodwill ties to the engine's recomputation from the schedule's own elements — a schedule that does not tie never signs, never applies. A declared acquisition with no in-effect schedule is labeled pre-PPA, never presented as fully consolidated (see the per-entity PPA status). Declared straight-line amortization of finite-lived layers is applied; no engine-computed deferred tax (declared DTL lines only, or named out) and no goodwill impairment testing (carrying amounts stand as declared) are performed.
  • Foreign-entity balances are translated per ASC 830-30: asset/liability lines at the closing rate, declared equity components at their own historical rates, and Retained Earnings rolled forward (opening translated RE + current-period result at the average rate, less dividends at their transaction-date rate). The cumulative translation adjustment (CTA) is computed via two cross-checked arithmetic decompositions (an engine-bug guard) and must agree to the cent or the figure is withheld; the declared closing/average/historical rates actually used are shown per entity on the CTA figure. Entities whose books currency differs from their declared functional currency, or that are declared highly inflationary, require ASC 830-10 remeasurement — out of scope here and refused, never approximated as an ordinary translation. Applied this build under rate-set versions ECB-CLOSING-RATES-V1, ECB-AVERAGE-RATES-V1, EQUITY-HIST-V1 — see the CTA figure.
  • A CONSOLIDATED entity's assets and liabilities are aggregated at 100% regardless of ownership %; its equity splits into parent equity and a COMPUTED non-controlling-interest (NCI) figure whenever ownershipPct < 100 (see the NCI figure, drillable). Consolidation requires a declared method + a signed control basis — never inferred from ownership % — and proportional consolidation is rejected outright. An EQUITY_METHOD entity is excluded from ordinary aggregation (a declared one-line carrying value substitutes); a NOT_CONSOLIDATED entity is excluded entirely; an entity with no declared method is refused (withheld), never included with a caution. Computed this build under registryVersion REGISTRY-V1 — see the NCI figure, drillable.

Unaudited management information only, prepared from declared, controller-signed inputs on a management basis — not statutory consolidated financial statements and not an audit opinion. Not for statutory reporting, covenant compliance, or investor distribution without independent review. This build could not claim the full basis-of-preparation ceiling this period — the named gap(s): confirmed intercompany-balance eliminations (SAPENT/160000).

Org-model decision
The source (CSD) org model is Company → optional Division → Warehouse with no facility tier (csd findings §U1); the target (CSDE) chain is CMNCMP→CMNDIV→CFACIL→MITWHL (csde findings [S10–S12]). DECLARED placements: company 10 → company 100; BOTH source divisions (1, 2) collapse into the single target division ADC; warehouse MAIN → W12 (DC1 pick/pack), warehouse EAST → W21 (DC2 regional). The facility tier is NOT mapped from the source (it has none to map from) — each migrated warehouse inherits its facility from the TARGET chain (W12→DC1, W21→DC2). The division section on source account codes is dropped by the account mappings, consistent with the division collapse. Every placement above is a synthetic-content decision (fixture-labeled); any org unit without a declared placement is refused, never inferred.

Capability & editions — declared packaging

CSDE ships in two documented editions; the two CSDE tenants declare one manifest each (Enterprise and Essentials — the same spine under different declared packaging, which is the documented relationship). CSD documents no edition catalog, so the CSD tenants declare NONE — the rationale is carried as data, not silence. Every manifest is content-hashed and rides the tenant’s derivation tuple.

CSD — why no edition manifest exists

The Phase-1a CSD corpus documents no edition/packaging catalog for CSD (zero "Essentials" matches across the seven public csdis libraries, re-checked 2026-07-15); a CSD edition manifest invented to mirror the CSDE pack would be an uncited structural claim, so none exists.
